532:t_2:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Which bastard planted that damned nuisance in us?!」

532:t_2:29.en:
$n
「You seem to have someone in mind.」

532:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I only have a vague image myself. If I were to put it into words...」

532:t_2:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This experiment is also intended to confirm that.」

532:t_2:35.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We will now touch the $$集合無意識|lc$$ beyond this door.」

532:t_2:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on! What is this $$集合無意識|lc$$?!」

532:t_2:37.en:
$n
「In psychology, it's a collection of consciousness beyond individuals, beneath the depths of the human unconscious...」

532:t_2:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is correct. We can call it a shared consciousness common to all humanity.」

532:t_2:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And it is also called the 《$$アカシックレコード$$》.」

532:t_2:40.en:
$n
「It holds the past and future of every event... In other words, it's a collection of all knowledge.」

532:t_2:41.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Doesn't that exist only as a concept?」

532:t_2:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At least beyond this door, it exists in tangible form.」

532:t_2:43.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is the world's natural order itself, an existence beyond life and death, time and space.」

532:t_2:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It is the power of the underlying principles... In other words, it's $$次元力|lc$$.」

532:t_2:46.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As you point out, I believe the $$集合無意識|lc$$'s existence is also related to controlling $$次元力|lc$$.」

532:t_2:47.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Why do you know something like that exists?」

532:t_2:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't know when it came into existence, or why...」

532:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But that tangible $$集合無意識|lc$$ is the source of $$ギアス$$'s power and what the $$ギアス嚮団$$ protected.」

532:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「During the $$再世戦争$$, I touched part of it in my battle with $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$.」

532:t_2:52.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I feel uneasy as the images I sensed there gradually become reality...」

532:t_2:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I associate it with the being who engraved the $$烙印$$... That is, with God.」

532:t_2:54.en:
$n
(Was $$ゼロ$$ feeling the same unease as $$クロウ$$, Miss $$スズネ$$, and me...?)

532:t_2:55.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To confirm that too, all of $c, who share the $$烙印$$, will attempt contact with the $$集合無意識|lc$$.」

532:t_2:56.en:
???
「You impress me, $$ゼロ$$. You are a capable successor.」

532:t_2:58.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You could have upheld its doctrine far more faithfully than the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

532:t_2:60.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Can you afford to focus on me?」

532:t_2:63.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You blocked my knife-hand strike with a single knife, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

532:t_2:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That was close. Without the resonance between $$リアクター$$s, I might really have let you kill $$ゼロ$$.」

532:t_2:66.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$ゼロ$$ can wait. I'll take him first.」

532:t_2:67.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You are the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$... You would come at me?」

532:t_2:68.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You were the one who killed the troops stationed here.」

532:t_2:69.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is correct. I eliminated those who stood in their way.」

532:t_2:71.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am the last one.」

532:t_2:74.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then, shall we begin?」

532:t_2:79.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$集合無意識$$! Show us the truth now!!」

532:t_2:84.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...The $$沈黙の巨蟹$$'s... No, the $$鬼宿$$'s power appears to have interfered.」

532:t_2:85.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now they will probably sense those who have already lost their bodies.」

532:t_2:87.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You impress me, $$熱気バサラ$$... Your power is the exact opposite of that of $$尸空#pilot$$ of the $$鬼宿$$.」

532:t_2:88.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Like I give a damn about that!」

532:t_2:90.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ told us to meet the $$集合無意識|lc$$! Then I'll do it my way!」

532:t_2:91.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, $$集合無意識|lc$$! Listen to my soooong!!」

532:t_2:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop, $$ランカ$$! Your song isn't meant to be used for that!」

532:t_2:96.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hate me if you want! But...!」

532:t_2:97.en:
$$アルト$$
「Please protect the songs you loved!!」

532:t_2:103.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Lend me your strength once more.」

532:t_2:105.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Why? Unless someone manages humanity, only despair awaits.」

532:t_2:106.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ knew that. That is why it built such a society.」

532:t_2:108.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「So, $$レド$$... Lend me... lend $$ストライカー#pilot$$ your strength.」

532:t_2:109.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Create a god to guide humanity, to protect those precious to you too.」

532:t_2:116.en:
$$宗介$$
「Answer me, $$千鳥$$! I'm right beside you!」

532:t_2:117.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I can't, $$宗介$$... Right now, I'm myself, and yet I'm not myself.)
